{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''peace treaty''' concluded the [[Seventeenth Alsakan Conflict]] and, by extension, the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]] in general. Its terms were established by [[Prince-Admiral/Legends|Prince-Admiral]] [[Jonash e Solo]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], who dictated the treaty at [[Sword/Legends|swordpoint]] before the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]].
